content.title: Blue Bell Is Bringing Back This Chocolatey Fan-Favorite Flavor for a Limited Time
content.text: Make the bitter winter sweet with this returning popular ice cream. Blue Bell Creameries. Despite the cold weather, it's hard to resist a bowl of creamy goodness, whether crafted with an at-home ice cream maker or straight from a store-bought tub. While everyone has a go-to brand they often search for in the freezer section, Blue Bell Creameries has stood the test of time as a popular brand among many. One flavor has remained especially popular among others, and for a limited time, you will see this chocolatey flavor stocking shelves yet again. Here's everything you need to know about its return, including the sizes available and where to find it. The Return of Tin Roof You read that right; The rich and creamy flavors of the beloved Tin Roof will be available again, and in a mega-size so you can stock up before it's gone. Instead of a usual pint, Blue Bell released the limited-time flavor in a half-gallon container (and no one's complaining!). The well-liked ice cream flavor starts with a smooth vanilla base and combines a rich chocolate sundae sauce with roasted peanuts dipped in a dark chocolate-flavored coating. Tin Roof is a timeless option inspired by a sundae created in the 1930s at a Nebraskan soda shop called the Potter Sundry. The shop is still around today, alluding to how loved this delicious blend has always been. Positive Reactions Are in Order Blue Bell first announced the return of Tin Roof on Instagram, prompting hundreds of fans to flood the comment sections with fervor. "This might be the best flavor ever" read one comment on Blue Bell's Instagram post. "I need an extra freezer so I can stock up," read another comment. Tin Roof is only available for a limited time, so you'll want to get your hands on a half-gallon as soon as possible before others beat you to it. To purchase a container, head to the official Blue Bell Creameries website, where you can get as many tubs delivered right to your freezer. If you'd like to seek out a container in-person, the website also provides a tracker for finding Tin Roof near you.
